description: This file contains PHP classes for testing command-line scripts using the SimpleTest framework. It defines a wrapper class for executing shell commands and a test case class for testing shell commands and their outputs.

classes.name: SimpleShell
classes.description: A wrapper class for executing shell commands and capturing output.

classes.name: ShellTestCase
classes.description: A test case class for testing command-line scripts and utilities, extending SimpleTestCase.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Runs a shell command and stores the output.

methods.name: getOutput
methods.description: Returns the last command's output as a string.

methods.name: getOutputAsList
methods.description: Returns the last command's output as an array of lines.

methods.name: assertTrue
methods.description: Asserts that a condition is true.

methods.name: assertFalse
methods.description: Asserts that a condition is false.

methods.name: assertEqual
methods.description: Asserts that two values are equal.

methods.name: assertNotEqual
methods.description: Asserts that two values are not equal.

methods.name: assertExitCode
methods.description: Checks the exit status of the last command.

methods.name: assertOutput
methods.description: Checks if the output matches expected text.

methods.name: assertOutputPattern
methods.description: Checks if the output matches a regex pattern.

methods.name: assertNoOutputPattern
methods.description: Checks that a regex pattern is not present in the output.

methods.name: assertFileNotExists
methods.description: Checks if a file does not exist.

methods.name: assertFilePattern
methods.description: Checks if a file contains a pattern.

methods.name: assertNoFilePattern
methods.description: Checks if a file does not contain a pattern.
